evidence.excerpt: Preferred collaboration topics are moisture ingress modelling and accelerated ageing test protocol development. She has an established outdoor test rack infrastructure that can accommodate instruments from partner organisations. Available for new project discussions from early 2026 onward; currently supervising two doctoral candidates expected to defend in 2026–2027.
